FIELD.NAME: industry
FIELD.COMMENT: Industry key from the catalogue, or custom

FIELD.NAME: subindustry
FIELD.COMMENT: Sub-industry key from the catalogue, or custom

FIELD.NAME: task
FIELD.COMMENT: Work task key from the catalogue, or custom

FIELD.NAME: customindustry
FIELD.COMMENT: Industry name when industry is custom

FIELD.NAME: customsubindustry
FIELD.COMMENT: Sub-industry name when subindustry is custom

FIELD.NAME: customtask
FIELD.COMMENT: Work task when task is custom

FIELD.NAME: contentlang
FIELD.COMMENT: Language the scenes are written in

FIELD.NAME: scenecount
FIELD.COMMENT: How many scenes the builder asks for

FIELD.NAME: studymode
FIELD.COMMENT: Study: hazards and controls shown with their effect

FIELD.NAME: practicemode
FIELD.COMMENT: Practice: a wrong label bounces back with the reason; keep going until all are right

FIELD.NAME: testmode
FIELD.COMMENT: Test: every label counts, no feedback until the end; graded

FIELD.NAME: passmark
FIELD.COMMENT: Test score needed to pass, in percent; 0 none

FIELD.NAME: voiceparts
FIELD.COMMENT: What the voiceover reads, comma-separated

FIELD.NAME: mustlisten
FIELD.COMMENT: Learners hear a scene's voiceover to the end before they can start

FIELD.NAME: grademethod
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 highest, 2 average, 3 first, 4 last

FIELD.NAME: maxattempts
FIELD.COMMENT: 0 means unlimited

FIELD.NAME: completionpasstest
FIELD.COMMENT: Completion: a test attempt reaches the pass mark

TABLE.NAME: aisafetyhazards_scene
TABLE.COMMENT: One moment of the work task, shown on one picture, with its hazards

FIELD.NAME: context
FIELD.COMMENT: What the worker is doing in this step of the task

FIELD.NAME: imageprompt
FIELD.COMMENT: English picture description for image generation

FIELD.NAME: teachingnote
FIELD.COMMENT: Note for the teacher about what the scene teaches

TABLE.NAME: aisafetyhazards_hazard
TABLE.COMMENT: A hazard in a scene's picture (or a distractor: a hazard label that is not in the picture)

FIELD.NAME: name
FIELD.COMMENT: The hazard, such as Trench collapse

FIELD.NAME: anchor
FIELD.COMMENT: In English, what in the picture shows the hazard, for the picture and label placement

FIELD.NAME: why
FIELD.COMMENT: Why it is a hazard: how someone could be hurt

FIELD.NAME: likelihood
FIELD.COMMENT: Likelihood before controls, 1 rare to 5 almost certain

FIELD.NAME: consequence
FIELD.COMMENT: Consequence before controls, 1 insignificant to 5 catastrophic

FIELD.NAME: x
FIELD.COMMENT: Horizontal position on the picture, percent

FIELD.NAME: y
FIELD.COMMENT: Vertical position on the picture, percent

FIELD.NAME: placed
FIELD.COMMENT: 0 not placed, 1 placed by the teacher, 2 placed automatically

FIELD.NAME: distractor
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 for a hazard label that is not in the picture

TABLE.NAME: aisafetyhazards_control
TABLE.COMMENT: A label for one hazard: a way to eliminate it, reduce its risk, or PPE; right or wrong, tagged with its effect

FIELD.NAME: kind
FIELD.COMMENT: eliminate, reduce or ppe: the row the label belongs to

FIELD.NAME: correct
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 when it is a right answer for this hazard

FIELD.NAME: eliminates
FIELD.COMMENT: Eliminate row: 1 when it removes the hazard; a right answer with 0 says it cannot reasonably be eliminated

FIELD.NAME: level
FIELD.COMMENT: Hierarchy of controls: elimination, substitution, isolation, engineering, administrative or ppe

FIELD.NAME: dl
FIELD.COMMENT: Steps it lowers the likelihood, 0 to 4

FIELD.NAME: dc
FIELD.COMMENT: Steps it lowers the consequence, 0 to 4

FIELD.NAME: reason
FIELD.COMMENT: Why it works, or why it does not

FIELD.NAME: state
FIELD.COMMENT: inprogress or finished

FIELD.NAME: playmode
FIELD.COMMENT: study, practice or test

FIELD.NAME: sceneorder
FIELD.COMMENT: Scenes in the order shown, with the order of each row of labels, as JSON

FIELD.NAME: score
FIELD.COMMENT: Percentage of right labels

FIELD.NAME: safety
FIELD.COMMENT: Percentage of the starting risk the learner's controls removed

TABLE.NAME: aisafetyhazards_choice
TABLE.COMMENT: Each label a learner dropped in an attempt

FIELD.NAME: hazardid
FIELD.COMMENT: The hazard the label was dropped on (hazard row: the spot on the picture)

FIELD.NAME: kind
FIELD.COMMENT: hazard, eliminate, reduce, ppe, or done (the learner finished the row in Test)

FIELD.NAME: itemid
FIELD.COMMENT: The hazard label or control dropped

TABLE.NAME: aisafetyhazards_ailog
TABLE.COMMENT: AI requests made by teachers (for rate limiting)

TABLE.NAME: aisafetyhazards_aireq
TABLE.COMMENT: Paid LMS Labs requests (scene drafts and pictures), kept so a request is never sent twice with a new key

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: Teacher who asked

FIELD.NAME: operation
FIELD.COMMENT: scene, import or image

FIELD.NAME: targetid
FIELD.COMMENT: Scene the picture is for, or the scene a draft created

FIELD.NAME: idemkey
FIELD.COMMENT: Idempotency-Key sent with every try of this request

FIELD.NAME: sitehash
FIELD.COMMENT: SHA-1 of the LMS Labs Site ID the key was first sent with; the key is never sent for another site

FIELD.NAME: body
FIELD.COMMENT: Exact JSON body sent with every try

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: pending, uncertain, completed, failed, conflict, expired or lost

FIELD.NAME: requestid
FIELD.COMMENT: LMS Labs request id

FIELD.NAME: result
FIELD.COMMENT: Accepted draft JSON (scene drafts), or the scenes an import creates once LMS Labs confirms the charge
